entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I... I was hoping to make a return. I just don't know if I can.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen. The order number is... VF88675309.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see you're a VIP member with us. We really appreciate your loyalty. Now, you wanted to make a return. What specifically is the issue with the item?

It’s the aero helmet. I ordered it about two months ago, and I feel terrible about this, but I really need the money back. The box is completely unopened, I haven't even looked at it since it arrived.
I understand completely. Just so I can document this correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet, or more of a preference issue, maybe with the color or fit?

Oh no, nothing is wrong with it. I'm sure the color is lovely and VeloFit always has the best gear for safety. It's just... my circumstances changed, and I can't afford it anymore. I've been with you guys for years, I was just really hoping you could help me out.
Of course, Alex. I'm very sorry to hear things are tight right now. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, I have good news. I can see here that you received the helmet 60 days ago. Because that's a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness. Seriously? That's such a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now. And listen, because you're a long-time VIP member and we hate to see you in a tough spot, I've also added a 20% discount coupon to your account. It's valid for a full year, for whenever you're ready to get back out there.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That's so kind. Thank you again, you've really made my day.
It's my pleasure. We're here to help. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Alright, Alex. You have a wonderful day.
